node.title: Re^5: Immediately writing the results of search-and-replace [OT - FYI]
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Thanks very much, I'll look into this as soon as I can! The module used to have perfect tests on CPAN Testers, but unfortunately ever since I introduced [mod://File::Replace::Inplace], there have been spurious test failures. I hope this is one of those cases, and I think you'd be ok to force install the module anyway, the core functionality is quite well tested.
